THEARCHITECT-GENESIS_COMPASS.title: Genesis Compass
THEARCHITECT-GENESIS_COMPASS.description: At the start of each combat, give each enchantable card in your starting [gold]hand[/gold] a random basic [gold]Enchantment[/gold] ([gold]Nimble[/gold] 3, [gold]Sharp[/gold] 3, [gold]Sown[/gold] 1, [gold]Swift[/gold] 2, or [gold]Instinct[/gold]).
THEARCHITECT-GENESIS_COMPASS.flavor: It no longer seeks the direction of the world. The world follows its markings.
THEARCHITECT-FOUNDATIONAL_COMPASS.title: Foundational Compass
THEARCHITECT-FOUNDATIONAL_COMPASS.descri: At the start of each combat, randomly choose 1 card in your starting hand that can be [gold]Enchanted[/gold]. Give it a random basic [gold]Enchantment[/gold] ([gold]Nimble[/gold] 3, [gold]Sharp[/gold] 3, [gold]Sown[/gold] 1, [gold]Swift[/gold] 2, or [gold]Instinct[/gold]).
THEARCHITECT-FOUNDATIONAL_COMPASS.flavor: Every structure begins with a marked line.
THEARCHITECT-CALIBRATION_RULER.title: Calibration Ruler
THEARCHITECT-CALIBRATION_RULER.descripti: The first time each turn you successfully [gold]Enchant[/gold] an [gold]unenchanted[/gold] card, gain {Block} Block.
THEARCHITECT-COPYISTS_QUILL.title: Copyist’s Quill
THEARCHITECT-COPYISTS_QUILL.description: The first time each turn you play a card you have already played this combat, draw 1 card.
THEARCHITECT-COPYISTS_QUILL.flavor: A familiar line invites the next.
THEARCHITECT-DISMANTLING_PLIERS.title: Dismantling Pliers
THEARCHITECT-DISMANTLING_PLIERS.descript: The first time each turn you actively [gold]remove[/gold] [gold]Enchantments[/gold] from a card, gain 1 Energy.
THEARCHITECT-DISMANTLING_PLIERS.flavor: Nothing well made is ever truly wasted.
THEARCHITECT-REFLOW_INKWELL.title: Reflow Inkwell
THEARCHITECT-REFLOW_INKWELL.description: At the end of your turn, if you played at least 3 different [gold]Enchanted[/gold] cards, put a random [gold]Enchanted[/gold] card from your discard pile on top of your draw pile.
THEARCHITECT-REFLOW_INKWELL.flavor: The last stroke becomes the first.
THEARCHITECT-PALIMPSEST.title: Palimpsest
THEARCHITECT-PALIMPSEST.description: Once per combat, after you play the same card for the third time, gain 2 Energy and draw 2 cards.
THEARCHITECT-BLANK_CODEX.title: Blank Codex
THEARCHITECT-BLANK_CODEX.description: At the end of your turn, if you played at least 1 card and no [gold]Enchanted[/gold] cards this turn, draw {Cards} additional cards at the start of your next turn.
THEARCHITECT-FINALIZING_SEAL.title: Finalizing Seal
THEARCHITECT-FINALIZING_SEAL.description: Upon pickup, choose a card in your deck. Whenever you play that card in combat, [gold]refresh[/gold] its remaining [gold]Enchantments[/gold] afterward. Does not restore [gold]removed[/gold] [gold]Enchantments[/gold].
